text: In 1980s Tehran, as missiles fall on the city, former medical student Shideh stays on in her apartment with her daughter Dorsa while her husband is called up to the war. After [a missile strikes their building|trigger|disaster strikes], Dorsa's favourite doll goes missing, and an orphaned neighbour boy's tale of [djinn who steal a beloved possession|origin|old beliefs and legends] starts to seem true. As the neighbours flee, mother and daughter are left alone with [a chador that moves like a ghost|images|ghosts and strange figures] and [a Dorsa who is not her daughter|rules|it wears a familiar face].
